summary: Iteration 2 — verified all 5 frontend bug fixes for the Dash Cam Expo app. BUG 1 (permission overlay): at BOTH 390x667 and 390x844, camera-permission card renders while bottom HUD/toggle-recording/save-clip are NOT rendered (gate up hides them completely), CTA click dismisses gate and REC pill shows 'REC' within ~2s. BUG 2 (speed clipping): speed-value bounding box top (432px) == speed-hud parent top (432px), overflow:visible, lineHeight:104px, fontSize:84px, height:104px — '--' fully visible, not clipped. BUG 3 (record after flip): flip while REC → new camera remounts, RE-RESUMES to 'REC' within ~0.5s; toggle-recording flips REC↔PAUSED reliably; flipping while PAUSED then pressing toggle correctly starts recording (aria-disabled=None throughout — never stuck). Dual camera row removed from Settings (verified: 'Dual camera' not present; Recording group shows only Clip length + Auto-start). Regression smoke passes: mark-event → impact-banner visible, save-clip increments footer-info from 0→1→2, theme-dark switches settings-screen bg to rgb(0,0,0). No console errors, only known deprecated warnings (props.pointerEvents, shadow*) already acknowledged in iter-1.
critical_code_review_comments: index.tsx flipCamera flow correctly awaits recorder.stop() with a 3s timeout race before setFacing(), which prevents the record button from getting stuck disabled — verified.

The `showCameraGate ? null : <bottom …>` gate is the right fix; the entire bottom subtree (SpeedHud + controls + footer) is unmounted while the permission card is up, guaranteeing the CTA can be tapped.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration-1 issues (theme toggle) plus iteration-2 bugs (permission overlay covering CTA, speed clipping, record button dead after flip, dual-camera removal) are resolved and verified via Playwright at 390x667 and 390x844 with permissions=['camera','microphone']. Use page.context.clear_permissions() + reload to force the permission-gate flow on web. In web preview, expo-camera's 'granted' state is derived from the browser permission API — must clear before reload to see the card.
